title: Reagan family feud over lost Spanish gold at Reagan Canyon
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Reagan family feud over lost Spanish gold at Reagan Canyon, about 1890s at Texas (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, in Big Bend, there's, you can look it up. There's a place called Reagan Canyon, and there's uh this huge epic tale of like lost gold and mystery and mysterious deaths of people from West Texas all the way out to San Antonio, Texas.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes along a story he heard about Reagan Canyon, a canyon in the Big Bend region of West Texas. He says there is a huge old tale, set around the 1890s, of a family feud over lost Spanish gold, with mystery and strange deaths reaching from West Texas all the way to San Antonio.
